evidence: Three SketchUp screenshots showed roof planes and window walls almost completely buried below the primary roof, while the Hipped type was too low and appeared detached.
root_cause: v3.2.0 forced every analytical intersection inside the clicked depth, reducing visible eave and crown heights to a few hundred millimeters.
repair: Wall Height now drives visible eave exposure. Analytical joins may extend in a controlled range up to 2.02 times the clicked depth.
